title: Happiness 2.0: The Only Way Out Is Through

sentences.en: How do you cope with unhappiness and distress?
sentences.zh: 你如何应对不幸与痛苦？

sentences.en: It's a question humans have wrestled with for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 这是人类纠结了数千年的问题。

sentences.en: It's a foundational issue for many of the world's religions.
sentences.zh: 这也是许多世界宗教的核心议题。

sentences.en: It's also what may have kept you up at night this past week.
sentences.zh: 它也可能是你过去一周夜不能寐的原因。

sentences.en: Lots of us have techniques to deal with pain.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人都有应对痛苦的技巧。

sentences.en: We hang out with friends to make ourselves feel better.
sentences.zh: 我们和朋友闲逛来让自己感觉好一点。

sentences.en: We exercise or turn to music.
sentences.zh: 我们去锻炼或者听音乐。

sentences.en: Some of us turn to drugs and alcohol.
sentences.zh: 我们中的一些人借酒消愁或依赖药物。

sentences.en: In recent years, researchers have run experiments to see what works and what doesn't work
sentences.zh: 近年来，研究人员进行了实验，看看在应对痛苦时

sentences.en: when it comes to dealing with distress.
sentences.zh: 什么方法有效，什么方法无效。

sentences.en: Some conclusions of this body of science are counterintuitive,
sentences.zh: 这门科学的一些结论与直觉相悖，

sentences.en: and some dovetail with lessons learned hundreds of years ago.
sentences.zh: 而另一些则与数百年前吸取的经验教训不谋而合。

sentences.en: Today, in the next installment of our Happiness 2.0 series,
sentences.zh: 今天，在我们“幸福 2.0”系列的下一期节目中，

sentences.en: we examine the difficult emotions that often sabotage our well-being.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨那些经常破坏我们幸福感的情绪。

sentences.en: How to deal with distress, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 本周《隐藏的大脑》带你探讨如何应对痛苦。

sentences.en: When Todd Cashton was growing up on Long Island,
sentences.zh: 当托德·卡什顿在长岛长大时，

sentences.en: his mom was the center of his emotional life.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是他情感世界的中心。

sentences.en: She raised him and his twin brother by herself.
sentences.zh: 她独自抚养他和他的双胞胎兄弟。

sentences.en: Todd's relationship with his mother has informed the next several decades of his life.
sentences.zh: 托德与母亲的关系影响了他接下来几十年的生活。

sentences.en: He is now a psychologist at George Mason University,
sentences.zh: 他现在是乔治梅森大学的心理学家，

sentences.en: and he studies the science of well-being.
Todd Cashton, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 托德·卡什顿，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Todd, your dad left the family when you were a toddler.
sentences.zh: 托德，你还是个蹒跚学步的幼儿时，你父亲就离开这个家了。

sentences.en: What was your relationship like with your mom?

sentences.en: Well, the way people refer to it was I was the mother's boy of my twin brother and myself,

sentences.en: and everywhere she went, I was in her lap next to her, holding her hand, inseparable.
sentences.zh: 无论她去哪里，我都坐在她膝头挨着她，拉着她的手，形影不离。

sentences.en: I understand that she was unwell through much of your childhood.
sentences.zh: 我听说在你童年的大部分时间里，她身体都不好。

sentences.en: When Todd was 13, his mother was hospitalized.
My grandmother took us to the hospital, my twin brother and myself.
sentences.zh: 我祖母带我和双胞胎兄弟去了医院。

sentences.en: And when we got there, so excited because it had been days or weeks since we had seen my mom,

sentences.en: and what it was like to be with her.

sentences.zh: 当我们到达山顶时，所有都在欢呼，

sentences.en: and I just said, can I just have a moment
sentences.zh: 而我只是说，能让我有一会儿时间

sentences.en: to just take this all in?
And I just wanted to sit on the edge
and just take like a deep breath of air.
sentences.zh: 然后深深地吸上一口气。

sentences.en: And the landscape at the Cochise Stronghold,

sentences.zh: 简直是一片绝美的风光。

sentences.en: And I had this thought of, like, I know I'm strong,
sentences.zh: 当时我心里有一种想法：我虽然知道我很坚强，

sentences.en: and I know that I can persevere at tasks,
sentences.zh: 我也知道自己能够坚持完成任务，

sentences.en: but I didn't know how strong and how capable I was.
sentences.zh: 但我以前并不知道自己竟然如此强大、如此有能力。

sentences.en: And then it's like, this is why you do the work,
sentences.zh: 然后就会觉得，这就是你努力的意义所在，

sentences.en: because this sense of awe of looking at this landscape
sentences.zh: 因为这种面对壮丽风景的敬畏感，

sentences.en: and the sunsets you just dream of sitting and watching.
sentences.zh: 以及那些你做梦都想坐下来静静欣赏的落日。

sentences.en: It's just a reminder of the richness
sentences.zh: 它正是在提醒我们去追求

sentences.en: and the vitality we're shooting for,
sentences.zh: 那种丰富与充满活力的生活，

sentences.en: and that the pain is worth the effort.
sentences.zh: 并且这一切痛苦都是值得的。
